answer_1.quote: We investigate the generation, definition, and usage of words, neologisms, and nonce words in the tasks of Reverse Dictionary (RD), Definition Modeling (DM) and Exemplification Modeling (EM).
answer_1.outputs: generated words (lemmas), generated definitions, generated usage examples

answer_2.quote: We tested several metrics to assess the models' abilities across all tasks. ROUGE-N is used across RD and DM to measure the non‑continuous overlap of n‑grams ... CER (normalized Levenshtein distance) and Acc@1/10/100 ... RD and DM are evaluated using SBERT representations ... The EM task is evaluated using the median perplexity of the prediction versus the target usage examples, computed with Minerva-1B.

answer_4.quote: Using the Prolific platform, we collected human judgments over 100 pairs of definitions (taken from the nonce words dataset) and nonce words (generated by our models). ... Italian native speakers are asked to read each definition-word pair and express two judgments about the nonce word on a 5‑point Likert scale: the perceived novelty of the word w.r.t. their lexicon and a score of adhesion to the definition.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators answered two questions per pair: (1) rate the novelty of the word compared to their existing vocabulary, and (2) rate how plausibly the word matches the given definition, both on a 5‑point Likert scale.
